scope: Targeted diagnostics using the submitted kernel; not an independent simulator, not field evidence, not a replication of the full original experiment
authoring_status: Only syntax checked in the report-authoring environment; this invocation supplies actual execution observations

internal_bypass_missing.setup: S-U-G statically length 2 but S-U booked on [0,5); S-V-G length 4 is free; horizon 4; all nodes in one control region
internal_bypass_missing.repair_goal: Discover an authorized local bypass within the declared budget; do not relabel bounded_no_candidate as physical infeasibility

prefix_release_omission.interpretation: Never count a tentative release as firm stock. Add a separately versioned conditional release forecast; a safe stop is not an empty tray release.
prefix_release_omission.repair_goal: Keep correct firm-supply accounting AND make tentative remaining-route releases available to prediction with explicit dependencies

unexecuted_suffix_not_updatable.interpretation: This exposes the current fallback contract, not an idempotency defect. A future explicit update request must distinguish keep-valid from recompute intent and authorized suffix replacement.
unexecuted_suffix_not_updatable.repair_goal: Add request intent and atomic replacement of legally revocable future suffixes; preserve entered segments and service commitments

family_constraint_activity.qualification: Edge capacity and reception capacity CAN bind; this does not establish absence of all congestion.

identical_prefix_distinct_full_candidate.qualification: Phase-3 labels were collected at S (tick 2), not this A state. This probe concerns deployment action identity and future data collection, not proof that those S labels are duplicates.
identical_prefix_distinct_full_candidate.repair_goal: Group actual interventions, including any newly retained tentative-plan state; do not mistake different discarded suffixes for different executed actions
